FAQs

What is CMLink Malaysia SIM?
CMLink Malaysia SIM is a prepaid mobile service by China Mobile International in Malaysia.We provide unique products and services to bring convenience and savings to customers who frequent mainland China and Hong Kong SAR. In addition, we utilise MY local mobile network so you can be assured of the same quality network coverage!
What are the features of CMLink Malaysia SIM?
Our features include, but are not limited to:
- Plan includes data allowances usable in both Malaysia and Mainland China. Data can be shared across multiple locations in Malaysia and Mainland China with no roaming charges.
- Multi-country or regional roaming data and voice add-ons.
- 1-Card-Multi-Number (1CMN) service: Receive SMSes and voice calls forwarded from your China Mobile mainland China or Hong Kong SAR number on your CMLink number. Your China Mobile SIM card no longer needs to be switched on. You can even apply for a new China Mobile mainland China and Hong Kong SAR number if you do not have one.
- 24/7 English and Chinese language customer service.
What type of CMLink plans are there?
We offer 5G plans with different data, voice and SMS entitlements to suit different customer needs. All our packages are available for purchase on a prepaid basis.Click here for more details!

All plans include:
1. Local minutes and local data.
2. Roaming data that can be used in Malaysia, Mainland China(selected plans) .
3. International call minutes that can be used in Malaysia to call Mainland China.
4. Free Caller ID and SIM delivery.
How do I purchase CMLink SIM cards?
You may purchase SIM cards via our official website or by downloading the Jegotrip APP. You can also buy cards through our WeChat Official Account:CMLink_MY.
Alternatively, you can purchase cards at our physical stores across Malaysia.
